music.summary: Filipino-Icelandic folk-pop storyteller Yaelokre brings the fantastical world of Meadowlark and its four masked Larks to The Castro, an all-ages show with doors at 6 PM.

music.name: Brian Eno - Ambient 1: Music for Airports (Envelop)
music.why: Presented in a 32-speaker immersive listening system for detailed surround playback.
music.summary: An immersive playback of the album that helped define ambient music, presented inside a 32-speaker listening space.

music.name: Motown On Mondays DJ Night
music.why: A Motown-centered DJ night built around exclusive remixes and rare takes on soul classics.
music.summary: Hosts DJ Gordo Cabeza and rotating guest DJs spin originals, exclusive remixes, and tracks that are close relatives of classic Motown cuts, keeping the floor moving with a soulful, dance-focused vibe.

music.name: Waterparks The (Almost) No Barricade Tour
music.why: A headlining full-band pop-rock concert on a touring run.
music.summary: Houston trio Waterparks deliver a genre‑bending, high‑energy set of modern alternative/pop‑rock—marked by unhinged between-song banter, a relentless stage presence and nonstop crowdsurfing—performed in an intimate, nearly no‑barricade format on their tour.

music.name: Whitechapel, Chelsea Grinthe Acacia Strainnetherwalker
music.why: Four heavy bands on one night, with Whitechapel touring behind its new album Hymns in Dissonance and The Acacia Strain bringing You Are Safe From God Here.
music.summary: A heavy deathcore and metalcore bill at Channel 24, headlined by Whitechapel, with Chelsea Grin, The Acacia Strain and Netherwalker. Doors at 6 PM, all ages.

music.name: Jake Shimabukuro: Holidays In Hawai'I
music.why: A holiday-focused Hawaiian program centered on virtuosic ukulele arrangements.

music.name: Mom Jeans, Happy Diving
music.why: A direct pairing of hooky emo songwriting with fuzz-drenched, wall-of-guitar alt rock.
music.summary: Mom Jeans brings their "sad bangers"—earnest, hooky emo tunes to sing along to—while Happy Diving supplies wall-of-guitar, fuzzy alt-rock.

music.name: Crazy Karaoke: Thursday Night Party
music.why: Huge 1,000+ song library plus hourly $3 “Crazy Hour” shots and an upstairs lounge with live feed.
music.summary: A wild Thursday karaoke party with a 1,000+ song library spanning every genre for solo, duet and group sing‑alongs, big screens and lively late‑night sound. Expect hourly “Crazy Hour” $3 shots and an upstairs “Next Level” lounge with seating and a live feed of the stage.

music.name: Mom Jeans, Happy Diving
music.why: A two-act pairing that matches singalong emo anthems with dense, fuzz-driven indie rock.
music.summary: Mom Jeans serve up emo-leaning “sad bangers” built for crooning along, while Happy Diving follows with a wall-of-guitar, fuzzy indie-rock onslaught.

music.name: The Ruckus Revival Presents Blitzmas
music.why: Blends burlesque, circus and audience-judged rap/slam battles into one chaotic holiday spectacle.
music.summary: An anarchic holiday-themed variety show that mixes comedy, burlesque and circus with high-energy rap battles and slam poetry, staging theatrical mayhem and audience-driven competitions.

music.name: BABE
music.why: Prioritizes queer community with a vinyl-forward, intimate dancefloor.
music.summary: A cozy, queer-focused semi-regular party built around DJ sets and turntables — typically vinyl-forward — creating an intimate, community-minded dancefloor for weird and welcoming crowds.

music.name: Club Music: S.Dot, Ecto, Miles Cobb, Two Seven
music.address: 424 Haight St, San Francisco, CA 94117, United States
music.why: All-club-music format with continuous DJ sets throughout the night.
music.summary: Club Music at Underground showcases S.Dot with local support from Ecto, Miles Cobb and Two Seven — DJs spinning club-focused electronic and dance sets all night long.

music.name: Heated Rivalry Rave
music.why: Centers queer intimacy and consent as the night’s core theme, with romance-forward performances and aesthetics.
music.summary: A themed rave inspired by the sports-romance series Heated Rivalry that draws queer ‘yearners and romantics’ to celebrate yearning, intimacy and consensual tension through dance, costuming and performance.

music.name: Momentum: Nova, Miss Crafty, SNAQ, Viciios, Ruckus, Kryptonik, Rco, 4choko B2B Navii
music.why: Two-room format committed to intense schranz and hardgroove.
music.summary: Momentum's holiday edition runs two rooms of blistering hard techno, schranz, and hardgroove and welcomes back the one and only 'Schranz Gorilla' Nova.

music.name: Underground Sessions: Bukavok, Zaarg b2b Dripit, NRVE, Shrike!
music.why: Open‑deck warmup and a Zaarg b2b Dripit back‑to‑back set amid a loud, DIY atmosphere.
music.summary: A DIY, low‑production electronic party that’s loud and dark, kicking off with open decks before sets from Bukavok, Zaarg b2b Dripit, NRVE, and Shrike. The lowkey vibe also positions the event as a pregame for a later SVDDEN DEATH show.

music.name: Cell Injection (Truncate + Drumcell), Volvox, Lindsey Herbert b2b Max Gardner, Vorspier
music.why: Features two international selectors making rare local debuts.

music.name: Lovefingers + Chungtech
music.why: Free-entry club night spotlighting dancefloor-focused techno and tech-house.
music.summary: Lovefingers and Chungtech spin club-focused sets of techno, tech-house and house.

music.name: Lucius
music.why: An unhurried, communal set that puts perfectly matched dual vocals front and center.
music.summary: Lucius's shows center on striking, mirrored sisterly harmonies and warm, retro-tinged indie-pop arrangements; spacious, reverb-soaked songs and relaxed pacing create a communal, listening-room vibe that highlights vocal interplay.

music.name: Nina Sol, Charles Hawthorne, Finishher
music.why: A resident-diva, performance-forward disco format that mixes DJ sets with theatrical acts.
music.summary: Five Finger Disco is a diva-driven, disco-focused dance party — DJs spin high-energy disco and dancefloor cuts beneath the mirror ball, with theatrical performances woven into the night; the bill features resident DJs Nina Sol, Charles Hawthorne, and Finishher.

music.name: Pura Saturdays
music.why: Multi-room, open-format Latin/reggaeton party with nonstop energy.
music.summary: A multi-room, high-energy dance party featuring reggaeton, Latin urbano, salsa, bachata and EDM in open-format DJ sets across multiple rooms.

music.name: reale, Rent Boy, mach5, Beverly Chills, swagbaby, 1ycia
music.why: DIY indiepoptronica format that pairs live acts with genre‑bending DJs.

music.name: Santa Con X-Rated - Mario E, Mark G
music.why: An adult-focused, holiday costume party with an intentionally raucous, X-rated twist.
music.summary: An X-rated, Santa-themed holiday party featuring Mario E and Mark G, promising a raucous, festive atmosphere and playful costume energy.

music.name: Santacon 2026 - Drei, Crow, Stu, Aidan, Elliott, AJ
music.address: 161 Erie Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: A festive, club-style showcase of emerging Bay Area DJs with dedicated lighting and visuals.
music.summary: An afternoon-long dance party from the Linen Series featuring five hours of dance music from emerging Bay Area DJs. The main room will have dedicated lighting, visuals and holiday décor, two full bars and balcony/outdoor chill space; Santa hats and ugly sweaters are welcome.

music.name: SATISFACTION
music.address: 375 Eleventh Street, San Francisco, CA 94103, United States
music.why: Dedicated all-night focus on 2010–2017 EDM bangers for festival-era nostalgia.
music.summary: A throwback EDM party spinning the biggest, most iconic bangers from 2010–2017 — neon and glow-stick-friendly with festival-era drops and a PLUR-style vibe all night.

music.name: Fleetwood Mac - Rumours (Envelop)
music.why: A 32-speaker surround setup that envelops listeners in the record.
music.summary: An immersive listening event presenting Fleetwood Mac’s Rumours through a 32-speaker system that surrounds you with the album’s sound.

sports.name: Lake to Ocean: A Nature Walk
sports.venue: Lake Merced Trail, 700 John Muir Drive
sports.address: 700 John Muir Drive, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: For a short coastal hike with ocean and skyline views and wildlife-spotting opportunities.
sports.summary: A free nature walk that meets outside 700 John Muir Drive along the Lake Merced Trail at 5:00 p.m., walking just under 2 miles to the Fort Funston observation deck with ocean and city views. The route offers chances to spot dolphins, whales, and hang gliders during golden hour.

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Tuesday)
sports.why: Get a free squash workout and play with local players.
sports.summary: An active, weekly drop-in squash group that meets at the Mission Recreation Center courts. Sessions are free and the venue is close to the 16th and 24th Street BART stations.

sports.name: Flight Club: Adult Flight Night for Ages 18+ at “House of Air” Trampoline Park (SF)
sports.address: 926 Old Mason Street, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Exclusive 18+ trampoline takeover letting grown-ups use all jump zones without kids around.
sports.summary: An 18+ takeover at House of Air trampoline park offering adult-only jump sessions Wednesdays and Thursdays from 7–9 p.m.; $20 per hour. Full access to all jump zones (The Matrix, Dodgeball Colosseum, Training Ground, and The Court) with upbeat music, lounge space, and beer, wine, and snacks available for purchase.

sports.name: “Silent Skate” 2026: Silent Disco on Ice at Union Square Holiday Rink
sports.address: Geary and Powell, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Skating under the holiday lights of Union Square with your own headphone channel is a one-of-a-kind SF winter night.
sports.summary: A silent disco on ice: skate laps at the Union Square Holiday Rink while headphones carry the soundtrack. Evening session, 7:00–9:30 PM.

sports.name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 - San Francisco
sports.why: A feel-good Saturday morning run for a cause, with distances for every level from fun run to half marathon.
sports.summary: Annual charity run in San Francisco with 1-mile fun run, 5K, 10K and half-marathon options, raising awareness and funds for breast cancer.

sports.name: Christmas San Francisco Hike / Stroll ("Let’s Glow SF")
sports.why: See large-scale light art projections and iconic holiday displays while getting a scenic workout.
sports.summary: A late-afternoon/early-evening free holiday hike/stroll covering about 6+ miles to visit six locations of the “Let’s Glow SF” outdoor light arts festival and city holiday displays, including Salesforce Tower, the Transamerica Building, the Fairmont Gingerbread House, Westin Saint Francis sugar castles, and the Union Square Christmas tree. Meeting points are Cable Car Roundabout at Aquatic Park (2:30pm) or the Fairmont Hotel front entrance (around 3:45–4:00pm); total hiking time is estimated at 3–5 hours.

sports.name: Golden Gate Park Sunday Roller Disco Party (SF)
sports.address: 6th Ave. and Kennedy Drive, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Skate to DJ-driven disco grooves and learn roller-dance moves outdoors with a friendly crowd.
sports.summary: A free weekly Sunday roller disco at Skatin’ Place in Golden Gate Park where a mobile DJ plays groovy tunes and skaters gather most Sundays from noon to 5 pm. On most Sundays someone is usually willing to teach a few choreographed roller-dance moves.

sports.name: RRC 5th Annual Holiday Breakfast & Awards Celebration
sports.why: Great chance to socialize with fellow club members over breakfast and celebrate the year with awards and giveaways.
sports.summary: RRC’s 5th Annual Holiday Breakfast & Awards Celebration is a free morning gathering at Mel’s Drive-In (3355 Geary Boulevard) on December 13 at 8:30 AM featuring food, giveaways, superlative awards and a possible visit from Santa; attendees are asked to RSVP and to submit votes for awards via Meetup private message.

sports.name: Santa Skivvies 2026: Holiday Underwear Run Through the Castro (SF)
sports.why: To join a playful, community-driven charity run that includes a drag show and lively afterparty.
sports.summary: A holiday underwear run on Sunday, December 13, 2026 in the Castro: registration/check-in at 11:00–11:45 AM, a one-mile run through the neighborhood around noon, followed by a drag show, awards, and an afterparty at The Lookout; free to watch and a fundraiser for the San Francisco AIDS Foundation.

sports.name: Sunday Morning Run
sports.why: For a low-pressure, all-pace 5K and post-run coffee with a friendly group.
sports.summary: Community-organized weekly Sunday run meeting at 10:00 at the southeast corner of the Panhandle (near the William McKinley statue) for a 5K through Golden Gate Park; recommended pace is 10–15 min/mile.

sports.name: Unicycle Club Practice at Circus Center
sports.why: To learn or improve unicycling skills with provided equipment, clear safety rules, and a supportive group.
sports.summary: Community unicycle practice at Circus Center open to any skill level; participation is free (voluntary donations recommended) and Circus Center can provide a unicycle if you don’t bring one. Attendees must sign a paper waiver, those under 13 need a supervising adult, and everyone is required to have taken at least one unicycle class with Ying Ying Zhao before practicing.

sports.name: Wrestling at the Beach
sports.why: Practice grappling and conditioning outdoors on the sand in an all-skill-level setting.
sports.summary: A free beach wrestling meetup at Ocean Beach on 2026-12-13 at 13:00; any skill level is welcome, but RSVP is required and participants must agree to a release/waiver. Under-18s can attend only if accompanied by a parent or guardian who also signs up.

sports.name: When was the last time you played catch?
sports.why: A simple, no-team format that prioritizes conversation over competition.
sports.summary: An informal outdoor meetup to toss a baseball, softball, football or volleyball — no teams or pressure, just catch and conversation; bring a glove if you have one.

sports.name: RISE + RUN W/ MORGAN
sports.why: Structured, community-driven training sessions with coached drills and themed runs.
sports.summary: RISE + RUN is a group running club offering guided sessions that combine warm-ups, themed courses, drills, runs and cool downs to help beginners and seasoned runners improve form, endurance and strength. The format emphasizes community and motivation through training together.
sports.promoter: Rise By We San Francisco Running Group

sports.name: SF Underwater Hockey Beginners Game
sports.venue: Martin Luther King Pool, 5701 3rd St (At Carroll Ave, near Candlestick Park)
sports.address: 5701 3rd St (At Carroll Ave, near Candlestick Park), San Francisco, CA
sports.why: A coached, entry-level introduction to underwater hockey with gear available for newcomers.
sports.summary: Trained coaches lead a beginner-friendly underwater hockey session that teaches puck-handling, breath control, teamwork and coordination in a limited-contact pool format; equipment and snorkel gear can be provided if you don’t have your own.
sports.promoter: Northern California Underwater Hockey Meetup Group

sports.name: San Francisco - Thursday Pickup Spikeball
sports.venue: Raymond Kimbell Playground Park, 1901 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94115, USA
sports.address: 1901 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94115, USA, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Drop-in, beginner-friendly Spikeball where community play and meeting other players is the focus.
sports.summary: A weekly casual roundnet (Spikeball) pickup — an open, friendly session where everyone is welcome and players of all levels, from beginners to experienced, can join in.

sports.name: Founders Running Club :: Easy 5-10km Run + Talks
sports.venue: Murphy Windmill, San Francisco, CA 94121, USA
sports.address: San Francisco, CA 94121, USA, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Casual group run that doubles as founder-focused networking with a post-run coffee.
sports.summary: Founders Running Club brings founders, investors, operators and creators together for easy 5–10km runs that finish with coffee and conversation; runners can choose their pace or follow a pacer, and pets, friends and family are welcome.

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Saturday)
sports.why: Casual drop-in squash with a social, post-game burrito tradition.
sports.summary: An informal weekly community squash meetup for pickup games and social play; participants often head out for burritos afterward.

sports.name: Volleyball. Training and Playing.
sports.venue: Ocean Beach, Stairwell 17, just across from Beach Chalet, 1000 Great Hwy
sports.why: Uses VBX no-net training to give players more touches and faster improvement before open play.
sports.summary: Sessions begin with three short VBX training phases — a no-net system that gives players more touches and game-like repetitions — then move onto nets for open play, with additional doubles courts added as the group progresses. All levels are welcome; the emphasis is on training first to play better and building a local volleyball community.
sports.promoter: Ocean Beach Volleyball Training and Playing. San Francisco
